flows.name: User Registration
flows.desc: New user creates an account via Fortify + Inertia

steps.label: GET /register
steps.detail: User navigates to registration page; Inertia renders the register.tsx component.

steps.label: POST /register
steps.detail: Form submits via Inertia; Laravel's Fortify routes handle the request.

steps.label: Fortify::CreateNewUser
steps.detail: Fortify calls the CreateNewUser action which validates input, hashes password, and creates the User model.

steps.label: INSERT users
steps.detail: New user record is persisted in PostgreSQL via Eloquent.

steps.label: User created
steps.detail: Eloquent returns the fresh User model instance.

steps.label: Redirect /dashboard
steps.detail: Fortify issues session, Inertia redirects to the authenticated dashboard.

steps.label: Dashboard page
steps.detail: User sees the dashboard — registration flow complete.

steps.label: GET /login
steps.detail: User visits login page rendered by Inertia's login.tsx component.

steps.label: POST /login
steps.detail: Credentials sent via Inertia POST to Fortify's login route.

steps.label: Fortify authentication
steps.detail: Fortify validates credentials, checks rate limiter (5/min), and creates session.

steps.label: SELECT users
steps.detail: User looked up by email in PostgreSQL.

steps.label: User record
steps.detail: Eloquent returns user data; password hash verified.

steps.label: Redirect /dashboard
steps.detail: Authenticated session set; redirect to dashboard via Inertia.

steps.label: Dashboard page
steps.detail: User logged in — sees dashboard with app navigation.

steps.label: GET /settings/security
steps.detail: User navigates to security settings page.

steps.label: Enable 2FA
steps.detail: User clicks 'Enable'; request sent via Inertia to Fortify's two-factor endpoint.

steps.label: Fortify generates TOTP secret
steps.detail: Fortify creates a TOTP secret key and generates QR code URL.

steps.label: UPDATE users (2FA columns)
steps.detail: Encrypted TOTP secret stored on user record.

steps.label: QR code + recovery codes
steps.detail: Frontend displays QR code to scan with authenticator app and recovery codes.

steps.label: Scan QR with authenticator
steps.detail: User scans QR code with Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.

steps.label: Enter 6-digit code
steps.detail: User enters the code from their authenticator app.

steps.label: Confirm code
steps.detail: Code sent to Fortify for confirmation; TOTP is validated.

steps.label: Mark 2FA enabled
steps.detail: Fortify marks two_factor_confirmed_at timestamp.

flows.name: Password Reset
flows.desc: Forgot password flow via Fortify + email

steps.label: GET /forgot-password
steps.detail: User clicks 'Forgot password' link on login page.

steps.label: POST /forgot-password
steps.detail: User enters email; request sent to Fortify.

steps.label: Fortify sends reset link
steps.detail: Fortify generates a signed URL and dispatches a notification.

steps.label: INSERT password_resets
steps.detail: Reset token stored in DB (or cache).

steps.label: Email with reset link
steps.detail: Notification sent via mail containing the signed reset URL.

steps.label: GET /reset-password/{token}
steps.detail: User clicks link in email; reset-password.tsx renders.

steps.label: POST /reset-password
steps.detail: New password + token submitted to Fortify.

steps.label: Fortify::ResetUserPassword
steps.detail: Fortify validates token and calls ResetUserPassword action.

steps.label: UPDATE users password
steps.detail: Password hash updated in database.

steps.label: Redirect /login
steps.detail: Password reset successful; redirected to login.

flows.name: Initialize Bot (tgbm:init)
flows.desc: Register a new Telegram bot token in the database

steps.label: php artisan tgbm:init {token}
steps.detail: Developer runs the CLI command with a bot token from @BotFather.

steps.label: TelegramBotManager::addBot()
steps.detail: The command calls the management_lib's bot manager service.

steps.label: INSERT tg_bots
steps.detail: New bot record created with bot_id (UUID), token, and optional secret_token.

steps.label: getMe() verification
steps.detail: Management lib uses core-lib's TelegramBotAPI to verify the token with Telegram.

steps.label: GET getMe
steps.detail: Sends getMe request to Telegram Bot API to validate the token.

steps.label: User object
steps.detail: Telegram returns bot user info if token is valid.

steps.label: Bot verified
steps.detail: Token confirmed valid; management lib completes initialization.

steps.label: UPDATE tg_bots (verified)
steps.detail: Bot optionally linked to a Telegram user as owner.

steps.label: Init complete
steps.detail: Success message displayed in console.

flows.name: Incoming Webhook
flows.desc: Receive a Telegram update via webhook

steps.label: POST /tg/{token}
steps.detail: Telegram sends an update to the registered webhook URL.

steps.label: TgIpValidatorMiddleware
steps.detail: Checks that request originates from a valid Telegram IP range (security layer).

steps.label: TgSecretValidatorMiddleware
steps.detail: Validates X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header matches stored secret.

steps.label: TgWebhookController@post
steps.detail: Controller delegates to core-lib's webhook handler.

steps.label: TgWebhookWithAutoSecretRequest
steps.detail: Validates and parses the incoming request, extracts bot identity from token.

steps.label: TypeDTOProcessor pipeline
steps.detail: Incoming update runs through pipeline: validation → anti-spam → logging → storage.

steps.label: Store update
steps.detail: Storage step persists the incoming message/update in the database.

steps.label: Response
steps.detail: Returns JSON {"ok":true} to Telegram.

flows.name: Long Polling (tgbm:poll)
flows.desc: Poll Telegram for updates via CLI

steps.label: php artisan tgbm:poll {uuid}
steps.detail: Developer runs the poller command for a managed bot.

steps.label: Resolve bot UUID
steps.detail: CLI looks up the bot UUID to get the token from database.

steps.label: SELECT tg_bots
steps.detail: Bot record fetched by UUID to get the token and configuration.

steps.label: TgBotApiDTOClient
steps.detail: Creates an API client configured with the bot's token.

steps.label: GET getUpdates (long poll)
steps.detail: Sends long-polling request to Telegram with configurable timeout (default 30s).

steps.label: Update[] (JSON)
steps.detail: Telegram returns array of Update DTOs.

steps.label: Process updates
steps.detail: Each update runs through the TypeDTOProcessor pipeline.

steps.label: Store update
steps.detail: Each processed update is persisted.

steps.label: Potential queue dispatch
steps.detail: Updates may be dispatched to Laravel queue for async processing.

steps.label: php artisan tgbm:monitor {uuid}
steps.detail: Developer starts the monitor command.

steps.label: Resolve bot from DB
steps.detail: Looks up bot by UUID to get token and config.

steps.label: TgLongPoller::run()
steps.detail: Starts polling loop with a callback that prints to stdout.

steps.label: getUpdates()
steps.detail: Polls Telegram for new messages.

steps.label: New updates
steps.detail: Returns any pending updates.

steps.label: Echo callback (each update)
steps.detail: Each update is passed to a callback that prints formatted output to terminal.

steps.label: Terminal output
steps.detail: Messages displayed in real-time in the developer's terminal.

steps.label: php artisan tgbm:outbound-daemon
steps.detail: Developer starts the outbound daemon service.

steps.label: Load all bots
steps.detail: Daemon queries all active bots from the database.

steps.label: SELECT all tg_bots
steps.detail: Fetches all registered bot records.

steps.label: Fiber scheduler
steps.detail: Creates Fiber-based async scheduler for concurrent outbound requests.

steps.label: Request ordering & correlation
steps.detail: Outbound requests are ordered and correlated for consistent processing.

steps.label: sendMessage() etc.
steps.detail: Sends outbound messages to Telegram via configured transport.

steps.label: Response
steps.detail: Telegram returns the sent message DTO.

steps.label: Log outbound
steps.detail: Sent messages optionally logged.

flows.name: Webhook Management
flows.desc: Set, get, or delete webhook via CLI

steps.label: php artisan tg:webhook {--set|--get|--delete}
steps.detail: Developer runs the webhook management command.

steps.label: WebhookManager
steps.detail: Basic-lib calls core-lib's WebhookManager service.

steps.label: setWebhook/getWebhookInfo/deleteWebhook
steps.detail: Corresponding Telegram API method called.

steps.label: Result
steps.detail: Telegram returns success/failure.

steps.label: Status
steps.detail: Result passed back to command handler.

steps.label: CLI output
steps.detail: Success/error message shown to developer.

flows.name: Send Telegram Message
flows.desc: Send a message to a Telegram chat through the core library's transport layer

steps.label: sendMessage() DTO
steps.detail: A caller (CLI, webhook, queue job) invokes sendMessage() on the API client. The request is built as a typed SendMessage DTO.

steps.label: Rate limiter
steps.detail: Request passes through configurable rate limiter (per bot).

steps.label: Circuit breaker
steps.detail: Fault-tolerance check — if API has been failing, circuit may be open.

steps.label: HTTP transport
steps.detail: DTO is sent via Guzzle or cURL multi-handle transport.

steps.label: Retry policy
steps.detail: On failure, exponential backoff retry is applied.

steps.label: POST sendMessage
steps.detail: HTTPS request to Telegram Bot API.

steps.label: Message DTO (response)
steps.detail: Telegram returns the sent Message object as a typed DTO.

flows.name: DTO Auto-Generation
flows.desc: Generate PHP DTOs from the Telegram Bot API specification

steps.label: php artisan tg:dev:dto:actualize
steps.detail: Developer runs the DTO generation command from the core lib's DevTool.

steps.label: Fetch API spec
steps.detail: Core lib fetches the Telegram Bot API specification document.

steps.label: API spec (JSON)
steps.detail: Returns the full API specification with all methods, types, and fields.

steps.label: DTOGenerator::generate()
steps.detail: Parses the spec and generates PHP DTO classes for all types (~250) and methods (~170).

steps.label: Write DTO files
steps.detail: Generated DTO PHP files written to misc/BAGArt/telegram-bot-basic-lib/src/TgApi/.

steps.label: New DTO classes
steps.detail: Developer can now use the newly generated, fully-typed DTO classes.

flows.name: Profile Update
flows.desc: Edit user name and profile information

steps.label: GET /settings/profile
steps.detail: User opens settings and sees the profile edit form (profile.tsx).

steps.label: PATCH /settings/profile
steps.detail: User saves changes; Inertia sends PATCH to ProfileController@update.

steps.label: Validate & update
steps.detail: Controller validates input and updates the User model.

steps.label: UPDATE users
steps.detail: User's name/profile info persisted in PostgreSQL.

steps.label: Redirect back with flash
steps.detail: Inertia redirects with success message.

steps.label: GET /settings/security
steps.detail: User opens security settings (security.tsx).

steps.label: PUT /settings/password
steps.detail: Current + new password sent to SecurityController@update.

steps.label: Validate current password
steps.detail: Controller verifies current password matches hash in database.

steps.label: UPDATE users (password)
steps.detail: New password hashed and stored.

steps.label: Success response
steps.detail: Flash message confirms password changed.

steps.label: GET /settings/appearance
steps.detail: User opens appearance settings (appearance.tsx).

steps.label: Select theme
steps.detail: Inertia sends theme preference to server.

steps.label: HandleAppearance middleware
steps.detail: Middleware sets the theme preference as a cookie.

steps.label: Theme cookie set
steps.detail: Frontend reads cookie and applies the theme class to the document.

steps.label: GET /settings/profile
steps.detail: User opens profile settings page.

steps.label: DELETE /settings/profile
steps.detail: Confirmed deletion sent to ProfileController@destroy.

steps.label: DELETE users
steps.detail: User record deleted from PostgreSQL.

steps.label: Redirect / (logged out)
steps.detail: Session invalidated; redirect to home page as guest.

flows.name: Docker Deploy
flows.desc: Build and deploy full stack with Docker Compose

steps.label: docker compose up -d
steps.detail: Developer runs Docker Compose to start the full stack (Caddy, PHP-FPM, Postgres, Redis).

steps.label: Caddy + PHP-FPM start
steps.detail: Caddy serves the Laravel app, proxying PHP requests to PHP-FPM.

steps.label: PostgreSQL starts
steps.detail: PostgreSQL 17 container initializes the database cluster.

steps.label: Redis starts
steps.detail: Redis container boots for cache, sessions, and queue.

steps.label: php artisan migrate
steps.detail: Startup script runs database migrations.

steps.label: Run all migrations
steps.detail: All migration files executed — creates users, tg_bots, jobs tables.

steps.label: npm run build
steps.detail: Vite builds the frontend assets (production build).

flows.name: Queue Worker
flows.desc: Process queued Telegram jobs with Horizon

steps.label: php artisan queue:work
steps.detail: Queue worker starts (managed by Laravel Horizon).

steps.label: Reserve job
steps.detail: Worker pops a job (e.g., send outbound message) from Redis queue.

steps.label: LaravelQueueConsumer
steps.detail: Job handler from management-lib receives and deserializes the queued payload.

steps.label: Execute outbound request
steps.detail: Job calls core-lib to send the actual API request to Telegram.

steps.label: API call
steps.detail: Core lib sends the request to Telegram Bot API.

steps.label: Response
steps.detail: Telegram response received.

steps.label: Log result
steps.detail: Job result optionally persisted.

flows.name: Composer Library Update
flows.desc: Update library symlinks via Composer path repositories

steps.label: Edit library source
steps.detail: Developer modifies source in misc/BAGArt/telegram-bot-lib/src/.

steps.label: Changes saved
steps.detail: Changes immediately visible via symlink at vendor/bagart/telegram-bot-lib/.

steps.label: composer update
steps.detail: Developer runs composer update from WSL shell to refresh autoload and lock file.

steps.label: Regenerate autoload
steps.detail: Composer regenerates the autoloader with any new classes.
